DRAFT: prepared for founder review
I'm working on a digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets) designed to help freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region manage client projects, track invoices sent, and keep track of revision rounds. The tool is bilingual (Arabic and English) and does not collect client data. I'm looking for feedback on this idea. What do you think?
